description: This file defines a REST controller for handling utility payment operations within a Java Spring application. It manages HTTP GET and POST requests related to utility payments.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentController
classes.description: REST controller handling utility payment endpoints, managing requests to read payments and process new utility payments.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve paginated utility payment records.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process a new utility payment based on the supplied request data.
